<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="156" fill="#110053"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="18" y="23" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="18" x2="320" y2="23" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="15" x2="325" y2="23" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="12" x2="330" y2="23" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="345" cy="18" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="18" x2="350" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="342" y1="14" x2="348" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="359" y="13" width="22" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="15" width="16" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="381" y="16" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Header -->
  <polyline points="31,73 23,81 31,89" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="81" x2="42" y2="81" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="55" y="87" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Asignación de asientos</text>
  <text x="24" y="125" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Detalles de tu viaje</text>
  
  <!-- Content heading -->
  <text x="14" y="177" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tus asientos</text>
  
  <!-- Informative banner shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="14" y="188" width="364" height="184" rx="7" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
  <rect x="14" y="186" width="364" height="184" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="215" r="9" fill="#4658E0"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="211" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="215" x2="38" y2="221" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="57" y="218" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Importante</text>
  <text x="28" y="250" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Si no seleccionas un asiento,</text>
  <text x="28" y="272" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">te asignaremos uno al momento</text>
  <text x="28" y="293" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">del check-in. La asignación es</text>
  <text x="28" y="314" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">automática y puede separar a los</text>
  <text x="28" y="335" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">pasajeros de una misma reserva.</text>
  <text x="28" y="357" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Conoce más sobre la asignación</text>
  <polyline points="344,352 349,357 344,362" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  
  <!-- Section -->
  <text x="14" y="404" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Vuelos de tu reserva</text>
  
  <!-- Flight card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="14" y="420" width="362" height="227" rx="11" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.6"/>
  <rect x="14" y="418" width="362" height="227" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Card top -->
  <text x="30" y="447" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Santiago de Chile</text>
  <text x="30" y="468" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">SCL · 18 jun 2025</text>
  <text x="329" y="447" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Lima</text>
  <text x="329" y="468" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">LIM · 18 jun 2025</text>
  
  <!-- Route line and plane -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="496" r="5" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="496" x2="310" y2="496" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="184,489 198,496 184,503 187,497 175,497 175,495 187,495" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <circle cx="316" cy="496" r="5" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <text x="30" y="528" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Vuelo LA 602</text>
  <text x="329" y="528" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Duración 3 h 40 min</text>
  <line x1="30" y1="543" x2="360" y2="543" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Passenger assignment -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="573" r="16" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="568" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="578" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="76" y="570" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Camila González</text>
  <text x="76" y="589" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Adulto · Asiento por asignar</text>
  <rect x="288" y="560" width="61" height="28" rx="14" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <text x="318" y="578" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Pendiente</text>
  
  <line x1="30" y1="606" x2="360" y2="606" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="30" y="629" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Puedes elegir tu asiento antes del check-in</text>
  <polyline points="346,620 351,625 346,630" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  
  <!-- Action buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="666" width="362" height="51" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="697" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#EA104C">Seleccionar asiento</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="742" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Continuar sin seleccionar</text>
  
  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="773" width="390" height="71" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="773" x2="390" y2="773" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,797 49,788 59,797 59,807 39,807" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="36,798 49,786 62,798" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="49" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Trips -->
  <g>
    <rect x="113" y="789" width="22" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="118" y1="786" x2="130" y2="786" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="118" y1="795" x2="130" y2="795" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="124" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Mis viajes</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Seat / current -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="798" r="16" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <rect x="188" y="791" width="14" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="191" y1="795" x2="199" y2="795" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="191" y1="799" x2="199" y2="799" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="195" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Asientos</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Help -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="274" cy="798" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="274" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">?</text>
    <text x="274" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Ayuda</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Account -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="344" cy="793" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="344" cy="804" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="344" y="827" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
  </g>
</svg>
